e.title: insurance-uplift
e.summary: 留存 uplift 建模（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：CausalForestDML/Qini 曲线，续保目标化
e.summary_en: Retention uplift modelling (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): CausalForestDML, Qini curves, targeted retention
e.summary_hk: 留存 uplift 建模（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：CausalForestDML/Qini 曲線，續保目標化
e.body: insurance-uplift（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做留存（续保）的 uplift 建模：异质处理效应（HTE）估计——哪些客户对留存干预（折扣/沟通）最敏感——CausalForestDML、Qini 曲线评估。对 RIAA：uplift 是精算之外、保险商业价值极高的领域——营销预算花在「本来就会续保」的客户上是浪费，uplift 找到「因为干预才续保」的人群；与 [[insurance-causal]]（因果推断定价）同源（HTE 方法）；Qini 曲线是 uplift 模型评估标准；与 [[insurance-survival]]（CLV）配套做客户价值闭环。
e.body_en: insurance-uplift (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) does retention uplift modelling: heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) estimation — which customers respond most to retention interventions (discounts/outreach) — CausalForestDML, Qini curves. For RIAA: uplift is hugely valuable beyond pricing — marketing spend on customers who would renew anyway is waste, uplift finds those who renew because of the intervention; shares roots with [[insurance-causal]] (causal pricing, HTE methods); Qini curves are the standard uplift evaluation; pairs with [[insurance-survival]] (CLV) for a closed customer-value loop.
e.body_hk: insurance-uplift（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做留存（續保）的 uplift 建模：異質處理效應（HTE）估計——哪些客戶對留存干預（折扣/溝通）最敏感——CausalForestDML、Qini 曲線評估。對 RIAA：uplift 是精算之外、保險商業價值極高的領域——營銷預算花在「本來就會續保」的客戶上是浪費，uplift 找到「因為干預才續保」的人群；與 [[insurance-causal]]（因果推斷定價）同源（HTE 方法）；Qini 曲線是 uplift 模型評估標準；與 [[insurance-survival]]（CLV）配套做客戶價值閉環。
